title: Renting a sewing machine from the library
ai_summary:
• University libraries now offer sewing machines for rent, promoting creativity and innovation.
• Students can borrow machines for free or at a low cost for up to three months.
• Library provides online tutorials and workshops to help users improve their sewing skills.

title: Developers don't understand CORS (2019)
ai_summary:
• Developers struggle with Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) configuration, causing security vulnerabilities and errors.
• Misconfigured CORS headers allow unauthorized access to web servers, compromising user data security.
• The issue highlights the need for proper web development practices and attention to web security fundamentals.

title: Epoll vs. io_uring in Linux
ai_summary:
• Epoll is a Linux event-driven I/O library with high-performance capabilities.
• io_uring is a high-performance replacement for Epoll designed for next-gen applications.
• Both Epoll and io_uring are used to manage I/O operations efficiently in Linux systems.
student_angle: None. Understanding Epoll and io_uring fundamentals is beneficial for software engineers working with Linux systems.

title: Building Reliable Agentic AI Systems
ai_summary:
• Researchers from MIT and Carnegie Mellon University are working on a new framework for developing more reliable, trustworthy AI systems.
• This framework, called "Trustworthy AI", aims to create a transparent, explainable, and safe AI system.
• The project focuses on building reliable agentic AI systems that prioritize human values and minimize harm.
student_angle: Learn Trustworthy AI fundamentals to stay ahead in the industry, especially with the increasing demand for explainable AI models.

title: Loupe – A iOS app that raises awareness about what native apps can see
ai_summary:
• Loupe, an iOS app, raises awareness about native app access to user device features and data.
• The app visualizes and categorizes data requested by apps, enabling users to make informed decisions.
• By providing transparency, Loupe encourages developers to rethink their data collection practices.

title: Show HN: TownSquare, a tiny presence layer for websites
ai_summary:
• TownSquare, an open-source presence layer, provides real-time engagement metrics for websites.
• Allows developers to track user interactions and presence without server-side code modifications.
• Tiny footprint, under 10KB, suitable for resource-constrained web applications.
student_angle: This innovation could grow internship opportunities in web development, especially in presence-layer engineering.

title: Slow breathing modulates brain function and risk behavior
ai_summary:
• Research shows slow breathing regulates brain activity, influencing decision-making and impulsivity in individuals.
• Scientists discovered a correlation between slow breathing and reduced risk-taking behavior in both humans and animals.
• This study emphasizes the interplay between respiratory function and cognitive processes in the brain.

title: Your brain was never designed for this much bad news
ai_summary:
• Brain overloads from excessive news consumption can lead to mental fatigue and decreased productivity.
• Social media platforms prioritize alarming headlines for engagement, increasing stress in users.
• News organizations often sensationalize stories to attract viewers, furthering the problem.
student_angle: Industry contraction is inevitable, but don't be discouraged – still pursue internships and build skills.

title: When I reject AI code even if it works
ai_summary:
• AI code may not always be better; human judgment and oversight remain essential.
• Machine learning models can be flawed, perpetuating biases and errors.
• Developers must weigh AI efficiency against the potential for technical debt.

title: SMPTE Makes Its Standards Freely Accessible
ai_summary:
• SMPTE releases its standards for free, increasing access to audiovisual industry knowledge.
• Industry experts can contribute to and benefit from freely accessible standards documentation.
• Free access aims to standardize global audiovisual content production and delivery.

title: Signal’s Meredith Whittaker wants you to remember that AI chatbots ‘are not your friends’
ai_summary:
• Signal's Meredith Whittaker stresses the importance of understanding AI chatbots' limitations.
• AI chatbots are not conscious beings and should be treated as tools, not friends.
• Recognize the differences between human relationships and interactions with AI systems.
student_angle: Don't get too excited about making "friends" with AI; apply technical skills to develop responsible AI solutions instead.

title: In the Weights is your new AI-centric vanity search
ai_summary:
• In the Weights is a new AI-powered platform assessing vanity metrics for social media influencers.
• The platform uses algorithms to calculate users' scores based on likes, comments, and engagement rates.
• The scores can be used to analyze a user's online presence and track changes over time.

title: Founders Fund’s outlier bet on humanely killed fish
ai_summary:
• Founders Fund invested in Shinkei, developer of humanely killed fish robot Poseidon.
• Robot uses machine learning to quickly kill fish, aiming for more sustainable fisheries.
• Poseidon is a refrigerator-sized robot designed for commercial fishing industries.
student_angle: Consider applying to Shinkei for internship opportunities in product development and AI.

title: Nobel laureate John Jumper is leaving DeepMind for rival Anthropic
ai_summary:
• Nobel laureate John Jumper joins rival Anthropic, leaving Google DeepMind.
• Jumper's departure marks the second high-profile scientist to leave Google DeepMind recently.
• Anthropic aims to develop more advanced AI models, competing with Google DeepMind's research.

title: Every new iOS 27 feature that’s worth knowing about
ai_summary:
• iOS 27 introduces a redesigned notification system with greater customization options.
• Users can now schedule and send audio messages with more precise timing control.
• New features in iOS 27 are more accessibility-focused, including live transcriptions for real-time captioning.
student_angle: Consider learning iOS development skills as Apple's products continue growing in popularity.

title: He made your free video player run smoothly. Now he’s doing that for robots.
ai_summary:
• Jean-Baptiste Kempf's Kyber aims to provide real-time control over remote devices through a unified infrastructure layer.
• This project follows his earlier work on VLC, a widely-used open-source video player.
• The open-source nature of Kyber allows developers to collaborate and contribute to its growth.
student_angle: This project demonstrates innovative application of software engineering principles; familiarizing yourself with its architecture is worth considering.

title: From PGP to Mythos: a brief history of export controls that didn’t stop anyone
ai_summary:
• Export controls have failed to hinder cybersecurity software transfers for 30 years.
• Governments attempted to limit access to PGP encryption, but were met with resistance.
• Despite this, Anthropic's latest model, Mythos, sparks concerns it may be next targeted.

title: Go eyes robotaxis and acquisitions after Japan’s biggest IPO of 2026 — here’s why it matters
ai_summary:
• Go, formerly known as SoftBank's mobility unit, has successfully completed Japan's biggest IPO of 2026.
• The taxi-hailing app aims to address Japan's shortage of drivers with its new capital influx.
• Go's IPO is expected to boost Japan's listing season and support further expansion in the region.
student_angle: Worth applying to, especially for internships in robotics or autonomous vehicle development.

title: Aura’s impressive e-ink photo frame doesn’t even look digital
ai_summary:
• Aura's e-ink photo frames connect seamlessly to the Aura app for easy photo uploads.
• Devices can sync photos from phone, web, email, iCloud, or Google Photos accounts.
• Frame's non-digital appearance maintains aesthetics, making it perfect for interior decor.

title: Every fusion startup that has raised over $100M
ai_summary:
• Fusion startups have raised over $7.1 billion to date, with a handful of companies securing most of the funding.
• Majority of funding is concentrated in few companies, with the largest being Commonwealth Fusion Systems and General Fusion.
• These companies are working on commercializing nuclear fusion, a nearly limitless source of clean energy.
student_angle: These companies are worth applying to for internships in data science and research roles.
